title: Steuerquittung für Opferkalb
Tax receipt for sacrificial calf
items.dataProvider: Egyptian Museum and Papyrus Collection, Berlin State Museums
desc:

This crocodile mummy was found during the excavations of Grenfell and Hunt in the Fayum. It is wrapped in linen and surrounded by a double wire. The eyes are made of painted cartonnage. desc: Nine coin moulds (terracotta) from Medinet el Fayum (Crocodilopolis). It is likely that these impressions were taken from genuine coins in order to produce counterfeit ones.
